create: Click to create a viewport tracer for the selected object; click again to remove all tracers.
Shift-click creates another tracer. Right-click opens tracer settings.
create_another: Create another tracer without replacing existing TKM tracers.
set_range: Set every tracer's start and end to the current playback range.
refresh: Force every tracer to rebuild from its object's current animation.
toggle: Show or hide the active tracer without deleting it.
offset: Select the active tracer's offset. Translate or rotate it to resample the path; its values are remembered by object name for this Maya session.
world_space: Rebuild the tracer in world space.
camera_space: Rebuild the tracer relative to the focused viewport's camera.
relative_space: Rebuild the tracer relative to one selected anchor object.
grey: Use the neutral grey color for every tracer.
red: Use the red color for every tracer.
blue: Use the blue color for every tracer.
remove: Delete every TKM tracer setup from the scene.
connected: Update tracers automatically after animation, source transform, or offset changes. The Performance setting controls update timing and sampling quality.
cycle_style: Cycle the global drawing style used by every tracer.
cycle_range: Cycle the global number of visible frames before and after the current frame.
cycle_performance: Cycle auto-update responsiveness and sampling quality.
falloff: Fade every tracer around the current frame.
xray: Draw every tracer through scene geometry.
